none: PAS CAM-E8EFD7: Roman Coin : silver siliqua of Gratian, AD 367-383 (Reece period 19)
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VRBS ROMA ; D/ D N GRATIA-NVS P F AVG

A pierced silver Roman siliqua coin of Gratian, AD 367-383 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads VRBS ROMA. Reverse shows Roma seated facing left holding victory on globe. Mint is Trier. See RIC IX, no 27f/46b. Also see WILT-1096C3. Obverse legend reads D N GRATIA-NVS P F AVG. Obverse shows a pearl-diademed and draped bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: - -//TRPS.
